mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate environment consistently compresses the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors seek yield in equities.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS below 0.2% for 3 consecutive months yet S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 8.0% in a monthly reading, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger a flight to safety, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE above 8.0% in a monthly reading yet S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales (HOUST and RSAFS) indicate a sharp contraction in consumer demand, which triggers a negative S&P 500 forward return over the next 20 trading days as recession fears intensify.
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both decline in the same month yet S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in 60% of such cases.

mechanism_narrative: During periods when industrial production (INDPRO) is below 100 and consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 250 (index level), the economy faces stagflationary pressures that cause negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100 and CPIAUCSL > 250 yet S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) decline by more than 0.5% month-over-month, it signals weakening consumer spending that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS declines > 0.5% MoM yet S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in 60% of such cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) signal aggressive monetary tightening, which causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as equity valuations contract.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS increases and CPIAUCSL increases yet S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: In the context of a labor market recovery (UNRATE declining below 5.0% and PAYEMS rising above 100k), the improving employment conditions boost consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE < 5.0 and PAYEMS > 100k yet S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) consistently signals weakening economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market participants anticipate reduced corporate earnings.
failure_condition: INDPRO declines for 3 consecutive months yet S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in 60% of such periods.
